name: Bai Nian Yuan Lian
source:
In colonial Hong Kong, butcher’s daughter Yip Chiu-di falls for wealthy Chan Jeff, only to be betrayed. She dies bitter, her soul sealed in an ash urn, carrying a century-long grudge that haunts his descendants and reenacts the betrayal that destroyed her.

[From [url=https://saro7.itch.io/century-grudge]Itch.io[/url]]
